definitions.explanation: A facility where young children are looked after while their parents are at work or otherwise occupied. Can range from small private operations to larger institutional facilities.

examples.japanese: {託児所|たくじしょ}に{子|こ}どもを{預|あず}けた。
examples.english: I left my child at the daycare center.

examples.japanese: {会場|かいじょう}には{託児所|たくじしょ}が{併設|へいせつ}されている。
examples.english: The venue has an attached childcare facility.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{新|あたら}しい{託児所|たくじしょ}ができたので、{通勤|つうきん}の{途中|とちゅう}で{子|こ}どもを{預|あず}けられるようになった。
examples.english: A new daycare center opened in front of the station, so I can now drop off my child on my way to work.

notes:
A general term for any childcare facility. Often used for smaller or temporary operations, such as those set up at event venues, shopping centers, or workplaces, as opposed to full-scale {保育園|ほいくえん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {託児所|たくじしょ}に{預|あず}ける: to leave a child at daycare
- {託児所|たくじしょ}{付|つ}き: with childcare facilities
- {一時|いちじ}{託児所|たくじしょ}: temporary daycare
- {院内|いんない}{託児所|たくじしょ}: in-hospital daycare
- {事業所内|じぎょうしょない}{託児所|たくじしょ}: workplace daycare

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {保育園|ほいくえん}: nursery school — a licensed facility with stricter standards and longer hours, primarily for working parents
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}: kindergarten — an educational institution under the Ministry of Education for children ages 3-5, with shorter hours
